description: Steam generator: a hot NAK (liquid sodium) primary tube running through a STEL shell, boiling a WTRV secondary side that feeds a TRBN stage.
name: steam_generator
why: Sodium-cooled fast reactors move heat from a hot NAK primary loop (operate ~500 C, boils 883 C, burns in air) across an intact STEL tube wall into an isolated water/steam secondary loop -- the two fluids must never be allowed to touch (a Na-water reaction is violent and exothermic). WTRV is placed pre-boiled here at 170 C to feed the TRBN turbine immediately; in a live build, back this with a real boiler running the 130-180 C band from heat_extraction_loop.
